d: Is the United Arab Emirates aiding the Houthis in their fight against the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia? Well, according to a probe by U.S. based independent news outlet DROP SITE, the UAE has been providing intelligence and targeting assistance to the Houthi rebels against Saudi-backed fighters within Yemen. The American and Israeli ally in the gulf has been accused of secretly sharing this information with the Houthi rebels.
